controles.affirmation: En fevrier 2026, l'EPA a finalise l'abrogation de la conclusion de 2009 sur le danger des GES et supprime toutes les normes GES pour les vehicules et moteurs routiers, avec effet au 20 avril 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In February 2026, the EPA finalized the rescission of the 2009 Greenhouse Gas Endangerment Finding and repealed all GHG emission standards for on-highway vehicles and engines with an effective date of April 20, 2026 (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: La NHTSA remet en cause le mecanisme des credits d'emission, ce qui pourrait obliger Cummins a passer une charge non monetaire allant jusqu'a la valeur de ses credits, soit 89 M$ au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: in the period NHTSA finalizes a rule, we could be required to incur a non-cash expense up to the value of our existing credits. At June 30, 2026, we had $89 million of GHG emission compliance credits (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Decision de la Cour supreme du 20 fevrier 2026 jugeant non autorises les droits de douane pris sous IEEPA
controles.verbatim_source: On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that U.S. tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) on goods imported into the U.S. were unauthorized (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Le 1er juillet 2026, les Etats-Unis ont refuse de prolonger l'accord USMCA
controles.verbatim_source: On July 1, 2026, the U.S. declined to extend the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) [...] we are currently unable to determine how future agreement revisions may impact our business (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Charge de 2,0 Mds $ liee a l'accord avec l'EPA en 2023
controles.verbatim_source: We recorded a charge of $2.0 billion in the fourth quarter of 2023 to resolve certain regulatory civil claims regarding our emissions certification and compliance process ; Settlement Agreements with the EPA, CARB, the Environmental and Natural Resources Division of the U.S. Department of Justice and the California Attorney General's Office (10-K FY2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance possible : l'accord est signe avec l'EPA, la CARB, le DOJ (division environnement) et le procureur general de Californie, et porte sur des reclamations civiles reglementaires. Ce n'est pas une condamnation penale.

controles.affirmation: Accelera : environ 2 449 M$ d'EBITDA negatif cumule de 2023 au 30 juin 2026 (443 en 2023, 764 en 2024, 896 en 2025, 346 au S1 2026) ; charges 2025 de 458 M$ ; arret de toute nouvelle activite electrolyseurs ; paiement net de 175 M$ et charge nette de 199 M$ au T1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Segment EBITDA (896) (764) (443) ; Total charges for all Accelera actions in 2025 were $458 million ; we intend to stop new commercial activity in the electrolyzer space ; resulting in a net payment by us of $175 million. These transactions resulted in a net charge of $199 million ; Segment EBITDA Accelera (346) au S1 2026

controles.affirmation: PACCAR = 13% du CA consolide 2025 ; les quatre premiers clients = 31% des ventes ; Daimler et PACCAR produisent tout ou partie de leurs moteurs ; chacun 30% d'Amplify
controles.verbatim_source: PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2025 ; our net sales to these four customers, including PACCAR, were 31 percent ; Truck OEMs that currently produce some or all of their own engines include Daimler, PACCAR ; Accelera, Daimler Truck and US Holding LLC and PACCAR, Inc. each own 30 percent of the joint venture

controles.verbatim_source: TOTAL SEGMENT EBITDA $3,061 $3,091 ; NET SALES $17,855 $16,817 ; Segment EBITDA as a percentage of total sales 11.6% 15.1% (3.5)

controles.verbatim_source: Engine segment sales for the SIX MONTHS ended June 30, 2026 [...] partially offset by a decrease of $130 million in heavy-duty truck sales principally due to lower demand, especially in North America, with shipments down 10 percent.
